world.name: The Vim Wilds
world.premise: Tiny magical specialists repair an enchanted lost forest through precise command magic.
world.style: Detailed polished 2D pixel-art fantasy mobile-game mascot illustration matching the canonical Nix reference.
world.composition: One full-body character, centred, neutral three-quarter view facing viewer-left, readable at 92 pixels.
world.palette: Shared deep navy, warm cream and muted brown neutrals; amber, turquoise and violet magic; moderately rich saturation.
rendering_rules: Two-and-a-half to three heads tall with a simple expressive face and a distinctive silhouette.
Warm dark outline, restrained highlights, readable large shapes and no excessive costume detail.
At most two permanent major props, with simplified hands and anatomy appropriate to the species.
Transparent background, no cast shadow, no floor, no border, no text and no interface elements.
Original design only: no named franchise, studio, game, artist, logo or recognisable copyrighted character.

actions.template: {name} makes one buoyant success hop using {motion}, shows unmistakable happiness, and settles exactly into the approved neutral pose.
{name} performs a short rhythmic victory dance using {motion}; {prop_motion}; the movement stays readable and returns to the approved neutral pose.
{name} performs controlled signature magic: {magic}; the effect blooms briefly, clears completely, and leaves the exact approved character unchanged.
{name} completes {project}, proudly reveals the finished work with a warm celebratory reaction, then returns to the approved neutral pose.
{name} performs a playful expert trick: {prop_trick}; only the canonical prop is used and it returns to its original place.

{name} performs a larger anatomy-appropriate celebratory leap using {motion}. Throughout the airborne motion, the head, face, torso, all canonical limbs and props remain fully visible, connected and unchanged; nothing detaches, disappears or is occluded. {name} lands softly and settles into the approved pose.
{name} makes one clear celebratory turn with {motion}; permanent costume and props remain attached and the character finishes at the original camera angle.
{name} gives an anatomy-appropriate round of applause and {prop_motion}, accompanied by a restrained burst of amber and turquoise sparks.
{name} conjures a small harmless surprise: {illusion}; the illusion vanishes cleanly before the approved neutral pose returns.
{name}'s signature finale: {signature}; it is joyful, role-specific, fully visible, and resolves into the exact approved neutral pose.

characters.name: Nix
characters.description: A teal-hooded firefly mage and lantern-bearing guide with a shadowed face, two amber eyes, two antennae and two translucent cream wings.
invariants: dark teal embroidered hood with warm gold trim
exactly two amber eyes and two antennae
teal boots and compact brown travel clothes
characters.motion: a small body bounce, quick two-wing flutter and light boot movement
characters.prop_motion: the square-hook lantern staff bobs without changing shape
characters.magic: the lantern releases an asymmetric orbit of three amber fireflies and scattered turquoise motes; the eyes and lantern brighten, with no text, glyph, emblem or geometric symbol
characters.project: a repaired miniature forest terminal lantern
characters.prop_trick: the lantern floats once around the staff hook and clicks safely back into place
characters.illusion: three tiny fireflies form a check mark above the lantern
characters.signature: the lantern releases a loose asymmetric constellation of warm light points around Nix, with no writing or symbol

characters.illusion: a tiny amber trail races in a circle and becomes a check mark
characters.signature: Vela dashes one tight loop and leaves a glowing speed ribbon shaped like a Vim motion
